subject: Model selection with overdispersed distance sampling data

messages.author: 9c6614a1b3d9e242
messages.subject: Model selection with overdispersed distance sampling data
parts:
Good day distance samplers,

Criteria and procedures for selecting among models of the detection function when distance observations are not independent, such that the distance data are overdispersed, were recently developed. Link to article. Cue counting surveys, some surveys of social animals, and camera trapping surveys are expected to yield overdispersed data.

Eric H
